title: Field Marketing Manager - Precision Semiconductor Metrology
description:
Field Marketing Manager | Precision Semiconductor Metrology
Abingdon, UK, with up to 30 percent travel

Reward and Benefits

  • £69,000 - £80,000 (depending on experience)]
  • A generous annual bonus, death in service and private health care benefits BUPA, EMI Share scheme (UK).

If you are a Field Marketing Manager who enjoys connecting advanced technology with the people who need it, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and own the regional go-to-market programmes for advanced semiconductor metrology systems.

About Infinitesima
Infinitesima is a UK-based pioneer in advanced metrology solutions for the semiconductor industry. Our patented Rapid Probe Microscope (RPM) technology combines the 3D surface detection of atomic force microscopy with high-speed laser actuation and interferometry, delivering sub-nanometre measurements at in-line production throughput. Our Metron3D 300 mm in-line wafer metrology system brings this capability into high-volume manufacturing, addressing process control needs for next-generation devices that optical and electron-beam techniques cannot meet. Metron3D is in use at leading semiconductor manufacturers, and we are growing our team as demand for in-line 3D process control accelerates.

We are looking for an ambitious and adaptable Field Marketing Manager to own our regional go-to-market programmes for semiconductor metrology. You will connect our technology to fab, R&D and advanced packaging customers, equipment partners and industry audiences through trade shows, technical conferences, customer presentations and targeted marketing collateral. You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Applications, Engineering and Corporate Marketing to build awareness, generate qualified demand and support revenue growth.
